method: Optimized isolated sequential fixtures, ambient enabled and Reduce Motion disabled. Two warm-driver baseline runs and two final runs. Fresh stable build uses identical phases. No compilers, samplers or other graphical fixtures overlap timed measurements. Reported CPU is app process percentage of one core. Memory is physical footprint. The fixture records source submissions, not presented display FPS. Changes to this fixture add verification and cleanup diagnostics, not a different timed interaction workload.
limitations: Small local sample, no all-device guarantee.
Old native shell performance parity is not achieved.
Instruments and WindowServer/GPU utilization measurements unavailable.
First GPU presentation is not hardware-hotkey-to-visible latency.
Warm reopening and idle CPU differences overlap run-to-run variation.
Initial cold-driver baseline retained as context, excluded from opening comparisons.
Leak-instrumented and sampling runs excluded from all benchmark comparisons.
